scripts.build:css: powershell -Command "$files = @('src/styles/variables.css','src/styles/base.css','src/styles/title-bar.css','src/styles/button.css','src/styles/modal.css','src/styles/settings.css','src/styles/upgrade.css','src/styles/layout.css','src/styles/sidebar.css','src/styles/chat.css','src/styles/file-tree.css','src/styles/debug.css'); $content = $files | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path $_) { Get-Content $_ -Raw } else { Write-Error \"Missing: $_\"; exit 1 } }; $content | Out-File -FilePath 'src/styles.css' -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline; Write-Host 'CSS built successfully'"
